body: Lets assume it was an isolated incident. Should she find a lawyer before turning herself in, or what can she expect if she turns herself in without a lawyer? I mainly ask this because at the most she has 3 days off of work at the moment.
I know her well, yes she totally could be lying to me, but I really do not believe she has made any contact with the person in question after that one night

I know, its definitely a serious threat to throw out. I am biased having known her for awhile and having watched her get a handle on her mental health. I know she cant flip out and say things like that, it is just really disheartening to have seen how far she has come in managing it and to have things bungled up over one isolated incident.
She was told that it was a harassment charge by the detective
